title: Linear Sweep

story.briefing: The network zone keeps no index at all. Before anything clever, the simplest possible search has to work correctly.
story.success: Sweep confirmed. The network admits you know where to look.

description: Given an array of values and a target, return the index of the first occurrence of the target. If the target does not appear, return -1.

examples.explanation: The first occurrence, not the last.

hints: Walk from the start and stop the moment you find a match. Which end you start from decides whether you get the first occurrence or the last.
Returning at the end of the loop instead of the moment you match gives you the last occurrence, not the first.
Loop i from 0 upward. Return i as soon as values[i] equals the target. If the loop completes without a match, return -1.
